## Purpose

A `*Kind` enum answers one question: *what class of thing is this row?* — so a renderer can pick an icon, a colour or a grouping key without re-parsing the raw event string it came from. In the two exemplars the kind is always a field on a neighbouring row struct (`TimelineNode.kind`, `WorkspaceAlert.kind`), never a standalone value, and the raw string it was classified from survives beside it (`TimelineNode.raw_event`) so nothing is lost by the classification. Classification is total: an unrecognised input lands on a catch-all variant instead of failing, because the projection must always produce a row. This is the read-only twin of the `status` role — a kind says *which family*, a status says *where in a lifecycle* — so keep the two enums separate even when they live in the same file.

## Convention

Folder: packages/core/src/domain/model/view/** · Extension: .rs · Files of this role in this subproject: 2

- Field-less enums, `pub`, declared next to the struct that carries them, with a serde rename attribute fixing the wire word: `#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]` on `TimelineKind`, `#[serde(rename_all = "kebab-case")]` on `WorkspaceAlertKind`.
- Derive set of both exemplars: `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize`. `WorkspaceAlertKind` adds `PartialOrd, Ord` and its doc comment says why (it is half of a `BTreeMap` dedup key), so any extra derive is justified in prose.
- Every variant carries a `///` naming the concrete raw input it classifies (`"pipeline.wave.complete" / "pipeline.wave.failed"`), and the catch-all variant documents where the unclassified original still lives.
- Classification is an inherent `#[must_use] pub fn classify(event: &str) -> Self` returning `Self` (not `Option`), with a `match` on exact event names and `_ => Self::Other`.
- Tests sit at the bottom of the same file in `#[cfg(test)] mod tests { use super::*; }` — one test for the known mappings, one asserting the unknown/empty fallback.
- `domain/model/` stays pure: no `fs`, no logging, no panics in this folder.

## How to apply

Add the enum to the existing `view/` module that owns the row struct it tags — `timeline.rs` for timeline rows, `workspace.rs` for workspace alerts. Create a new `.rs` only when the whole view is new; then declare it as a private `mod x;` in `packages/core/src/domain/model/view/mod.rs` and re-export the type explicitly in that file's `pub use` list (the module never exposes `pub mod`). Cross-cutting enums shared by several views (`Phase`, `Scope`) belong in `mod.rs` itself, not in a leaf module. Because these types are serde contracts other crates render against, a new variant must be additive: keep the existing wire words byte-identical and give the new one its own `///` explaining the distinction it buys.

## Examples

- Ref: packages/core/src/domain/model/view/timeline.rs — `TimelineKind` + `classify`, with `Other` as the total fallback.
- Ref: packages/core/src/domain/model/view/workspace.rs — `WorkspaceAlertKind`, kebab-case wire words, `Ord` derived with a documented reason.
- Ref: packages/core/src/domain/model/view/mod.rs — the private-`mod` + explicit `pub use` re-export list a new file must join.
